Ruler ticks drawn between two rows.

`"neon"` turns the lines into glowing tubes: proximity raises the glow,
a hot beam of light rides every pluck, labels glow on hover, and the
current line breathes. Made for dark surfaces.

Neon only: on a display that reports HDR, draw the light in a WebGPU
canvas with extended tone mapping, so the tubes run brighter than SDR
white and the beam peaks around 1000 nits. Elsewhere the CSS glow
stays on its own.

Plays a cue each time a mouse or pen plucks a line: `hover` for an
item's line, a softer `tick` for a ruler tick. Off by default; only
audible once the user has enabled sound.

Centered white Poppins semibold text, only 4px radius, contrasting a flat colour block with an organic liquid silhouette.

units.descriptionZh: 三张高饱和撞色卡片并排，每张内部叠放巨大的黑色几何形（圆、圆角方、尖角菱形），像拼贴海报一样压在文字下方。价格用超大粗体白字压住图形，顶部有半透明胶囊标签，底部是等宽字体的白色按钮。
units.descriptionEn: Three saturated colour cards sit side by side, each layered with a huge black geometric shape — a circle, a rounded square, a pointed diamond — collaged behind the text like a poster. Oversized bold white pricing type overlaps the shapes, a translucent pill label sits top-left, and a monospace white button anchors the bottom.

units.descriptionZh: 深色星空底上铺满细密星点，底部由紫罗兰渐变过渡到深蓝，中央超大无衬线标题带金属银灰渐变，胶囊按钮外裹一圈柔和光晕，整体像夜空中的发光招牌。
units.descriptionEn: A deep night-sky canvas speckled with fine stars, its lower half washed in a violet-to-blue gradient. An oversized sans-serif headline carries a metallic silver sheen, while a pill button sits inside a soft halo of light, reading like a glowing signboard in the dark.

units.descriptionZh: 深色背景上一枚正圆头像，内部由多层同心圆环叠成，从中心亮紫向外逐渐变暗，边缘带柔和紫色光晕；正中是白色双斜块标志，整体像水波扩散的发光徽章。
units.descriptionEn: A perfectly circular avatar on a dark backdrop, built from concentric rings that fade from bright violet at the centre to deeper purple outward, with a soft violet glow bleeding past the edge. A white double-parallelogram mark sits at the centre, giving it the feel of a glowing ripple badge.

units.descriptionZh: 整体是一条细黑描边的全圆角胶囊容器，内部等距排列大写无衬线标签，字距舒展、留白充裕。选中项以实心黑胶囊反白文字呈现，与容器描边形成黑白双层的极简对比。
units.descriptionEn: A fully rounded pill container drawn with a thin black outline holds evenly spaced uppercase sans-serif labels with generous letter spacing. The active item becomes a solid black pill with reversed white text, creating a crisp two-layer black-and-white contrast against the outlined shell.

units.descriptionZh: 纯黑背景上以点阵构成深蓝地球，外发光晕与细轨道弧线环绕；左侧为白色标题与四张半透明深灰数据卡，卡片带浅色描边和微弱内发光，主按钮为电光蓝胶囊配2px同色外环。
units.descriptionEn: A pure-black hero with a dotted deep-blue globe wrapped in a soft cyan halo and thin orbital arcs. Left side stacks a white headline, muted grey subcopy, and four translucent dark stat cards with hairline borders and faint inner glow; the primary CTA is an electric-blue pill with a 2px same-hue ring.
